fusions.name: Milestone Sighting
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its armour. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Heel Nick
fusions.desc: A cut at the heel that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Already There
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Roadside Vigil
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
